Package models.users

Class GraduateStudent

java.lang.Object
models.users.User
models.users.Student
models.users.GraduateStudent
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<Student>
public class GraduateStudent extends Student
Represents a graduate student (Master or PhD). Graduate students always have a research supervisor. The supervisor must have h-index >= 3, otherwise LowHIndexException is thrown.

      public boolean equals(Object o)
      Description copied from class: Student
      Two students are equal if they have the same ID and email. Mutable fields like GPA and credits are NOT compared because the same student can exist as different instances across serialized objects (Database vs CourseRegistry).
